newsitem.title: USA: CME August pork bellies up limit on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME August pork bellies up limit on short covering.

text.p: Short covering boosted CME August pork belly futures limit up and to a new contract high early, traders said.
Some traders tried to sell against initial buying linked to Tuesday's bullish CME out-of-town report found little follow-through selling interest and were forced to cover.
August posted a new contract high of 92.625 cents per lb at the daily limit with February also up limit briefly. Futures are currently up 1.225 to 2.800 cent with July up 2.000 at 93.600 cents.
The out-of-town report showed a large net out-movement of 1.205 million lbs, which greatly exceeded expectations.
